scope: Offline Linux detector+hero+buttons+board benchmark. Synthetic tiled frames from reused labeled development crops, not Windows capture or independent live tables. Identical repeated tiles deliberately favor exact OCR reuse; diverse tiles are reported separately. No cross-frame caching. Cold means first call per scenario/mode in this process, not OS cold boot.

methodology_limits: Five-sample p95 is exploratory and close to the largest observation, not stable tail-latency evidence.
Fixed baseline then memo order can introduce order/warmup bias.
Synthetic tiling is not proof of live six-table capacity; repeated identical tiles favor cache reuse.
